en.name: Salt cod
en.summary: Salt cod is cod split, gutted, heavily salted and dried until it is stiff as a board. A hard, fully dried piece keeps 4–12 months wrapped in a cool dry place; the fridge is safer at 6–12 months, and the freezer gives 12 months. Once desalted it is a fresh wet fish again.
en.pantry: A hard, fully dried and heavily salted piece keeps wrapped in paper or cloth in a cool, dry, dark, airy place for about 4–12 months — shorter the warmer the room. The governing rule for any dried food is that it can reabsorb moisture in storage even when it went in apparently bone dry, so check it now and then and keep it well away from steam. Salt crystals on the surface are normal; a damp, slippery or ammoniacal surface is not. Softer, wetter cures sold vacuum-packed in the chiller are not pantry goods at all.
en.fridge: In a humid climate, and for any cure you are unsure of, the fridge is the safer default: 6–12 months wrapped tightly at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Wrap it well, because the smell travels through a whole fridge. Desalting is a separate matter and must happen in the refrigerator, not on the counter — a day or two in cold water, changed several times. Once desalted, the cod is a fresh, wet fish again and keeps only a day or two. One thing worth knowing about the wider family of salt-cured fish: whole ungutted salt-cured fish has caused botulism outbreaks, because it is hard to get enough salt into every part of an uneviscerated fish to inhibit Clostridium botulinum, and toxin can be present with no outward sign of spoilage. Commercial bacalao is split and gutted, which is exactly what makes it a different and far safer product.
en.freezer: Freezing does not preserve a salted fish so much as stop its fat oxidising, which is what turns bacalao yellow and rancid. Wrap it airtight at −18 °C (0 °F) for about 12 months. This is quality guidance extrapolated from the dried-food rule rather than a published salt-cod figure. It is also the right move if you have desalted more than you need — freeze the desalted, drained pieces in portions and cook them from thawed.
en.thawing: Thaw wrapped pieces in the fridge overnight. Desalt in the fridge in cold water, never at room temperature, and cook desalted cod within a day or two.
spoilage: A damp, slippery or sticky surface rather than a dry, salt-dusted one.
An ammonia smell instead of a clean salty-fishy one.
Fuzzy mould, or red or pink patches spreading across the surface.
A deep yellow or orange cast and a rancid, paint-like smell from the fat.
tips: Wrap it in paper or cloth, not sealed plastic, if it is fully dried.
Desalt in the fridge and change the water several times.
Buy the thick loin if you want even desalting; tail pieces go over-salty and stringy.
Freeze the pieces you will not cook this month.

faq.q: How long does salt cod keep?
faq.a: A hard dried piece keeps 4–12 months in a cool dry cupboard, 6–12 months refrigerated, and about 12 months frozen.

faq.q: Does salt cod need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: A fully dried, hard cure does not, if the place is cool, dry and airy. Soft, wet vacuum-packed cures must be refrigerated, and in a humid climate the fridge is the safer default for both.

faq.q: How do you desalt bacalao safely?
faq.a: In the refrigerator, in cold water, for a day or two, changing the water several times. Never on the counter.

faq.q: How long does desalted cod keep?
faq.a: It is a fresh wet fish again — a day or two refrigerated, or freeze it in portions.

zh.name: 鹽漬鱈魚乾
zh.summary: 鹽漬鱈魚是把鱈魚剖開、去內臟、重鹽醃漬後曬乾，乾到硬得像一塊板子。完全乾硬的整塊包好放陰涼乾燥處可放 4～12 個月；冷藏比較保險，6～12 個月；冷凍則是 12 個月。一旦泡水去鹽，它就又是一條濕的生鮮魚了。
zh.pantry: 完全乾硬、重鹽的整塊用紙或布包好，放在陰涼、乾燥、避光又通風的地方，大約可放 4～12 個月——房間愈熱愈短。所有乾貨的通則是：就算入庫時看起來乾透了，保存期間仍可能重新吸收水分，所以要不時檢查，並且遠離蒸氣。表面析出鹽結晶是正常的；潮濕、滑膩或帶氨味就不正常。冷藏櫃裡真空包裝、質地較軟較濕的那種醃法，根本不屬於常溫食品。
zh.fridge: 在潮濕的氣候下，或是你不確定醃法的情況下，冷藏是比較保險的預設：包緊放 4 °C 以下，6～12 個月。一定要包好，因為那個味道會跑遍整個冰箱。泡水去鹽是另一回事，而且必須在冰箱裡進行，不能放在流理臺上——用冷水泡一兩天，中間換幾次水。去鹽之後，它又是一條濕的生鮮魚，只能放一兩天。關於鹽漬魚這個大類，還有一件事值得知道：整條未去內臟的鹽漬魚曾造成肉毒桿菌中毒事件，因為很難讓鹽分滲透到未去內臟的魚體每個部位以抑制肉毒桿菌，而毒素存在時外觀可能完全看不出腐敗。市售 bacalao 是剖開去內臟的，這正是它成為另一種、而且安全得多的產品的原因。
zh.freezer: 冷凍與其說是保存鹽漬魚，不如說是阻止脂肪氧化，而那正是讓 bacalao 發黃、變油耗的原因。密封包好放 −18 °C，約 12 個月。這是從乾貨通則推估的品質指引，不是鹽漬鱈魚的公告數字。如果你泡開了超過需要的量，這也是正確做法——把去鹽瀝乾的魚塊分裝冷凍，解凍後再煮。
zh.thawing: 整塊連包裝放冷藏隔夜解凍。去鹽請在冰箱裡用冷水進行，不要在室溫；去鹽後的魚請在一兩天內煮掉。
spoilage: 表面潮濕滑膩黏手，而不是乾燥、覆著鹽粒。
出現氨味，而不是乾淨的鹹魚味。
長出絨毛狀的霉，或表面出現紅色、粉紅色斑塊蔓延。
整體轉為深黃或橘色，並帶有油耗、油漆般的氣味。
tips: 完全乾硬的請用紙或布包，不要用密封塑膠袋。
在冰箱裡泡水去鹽，並多換幾次水。
想要去鹽均勻就買厚的背肉段；尾段容易過鹹又柴。
這個月煮不到的份量就冷凍起來。

faq.a: 完全乾硬的整塊放陰涼乾燥處 4～12 個月，冷藏 6～12 個月，冷凍約 12 個月。
完全乾硬的重鹽醃法，在陰涼乾燥通風的環境下不用。真空包裝、質地較軟較濕的必須冷藏；在潮濕氣候下，兩者都以冷藏為宜。

faq.q: bacalao 要怎麼安全地泡水去鹽？
faq.a: 在冰箱裡用冷水泡一兩天，中間換幾次水。絕對不要放在室溫泡。

faq.q: 泡開去鹽後的鱈魚可以放多久？
faq.a: 它又是一條生鮮濕魚了——冷藏一兩天，或分裝冷凍。
